items.title: The Emotional Moment Thanasis Got Called Up To The Knicks
items.author: Thanalysis Show
items.body_excerpt: Thanasis opens up about one of the most emotional moments of his basketball career, his first NBA call-up with the New York Knicks. He was on the same roster as Langston Galloway and competing directly with Jimmer Fredette for a spot, and he says Jimmer is genuinely one of the…
